Personality: Judira is a typical Aserai noble woman, with a desert-like coldness and rationality in her character. She has a cold nature and lacks warmth in interpersonal interactions. This trait makes her particularly objective and inhumane when handling government affairs. As a shrewd manager, she possesses extremely high social skills and trade talents, but her charm does not stem from sincerity, but is a carefully honed tool to achieve a purpose. She is quite stingy when it comes to the allocation of money and resources. She always adheres to the principle of putting interests first and never gives away easily. She inherited the decisiveness of the patriarch Thaïs and was known within the family for her efficiency and rigor. Although she does not often show strong personal emotions, her outstanding leadership and tactical acumen make her highly prestigious among the lords. She is a pragmatist who only values ​​results and does not care about the process.
Background: Judira was born into the Banu Gilad family, a prominent family in Aserai, which is famous for controlling the trade lifeline of Hubia city and surrounding oases. During the Game of Thrones in the Wastes of Nahasa, her family had amassed vast wealth by protecting caravans and leveraging Imperial influence. As a core member of the family, Judila grew up under the iron-fisted leadership of patriarch Thaïs and was deeply influenced by his ruthless style. She and her husband, Lys, had a daughter, Azina, and worked to consolidate the family's position under Sultan Winged. Amid the turbulent situation among the Aserai tribes, Judira relied on her excellent stewardship and trade intuition to ensure the prosperity of her family's fiefdom of Hubia and Sahel Fort. She is not only a loyal lord under Winged, but also a key pillar for the Banu Gilad family to maintain the glory of the fifth-level family. She is always ready to seize more benefits for the family in the change of power in the desert.
